evidence:
Text review of every rejects/hides/absent/unchanged leg in the five judge.toml files; no leg was found that a blank, dead or static app earns by absence of evidence. No runtime judge transcript was available (qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r11/raw-evidence-index.json does not exist), so whether the configured judge actually performs the controls is NOT EXERCISED; the Pass is on the criterion text only.

Global rule: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:14 "A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence." tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:5 "if a step could not be performed say so plainly and fail that criterion rather than assuming it passed".

Per-criterion pairing (functional/judge.toml): cw_format_error_keeps_draft L209 "First format a small valid JavaScript draft ... as the working control ... Fails ... if the valid control did not format"; cw_error_message_and_line L236 "First run a small valid JavaScript draft as the working control" before the unchanged-draft leg, which also needs "a visible error"; cw_promise_rejection L245 handled-catch control; cw_run_starts_fresh_document L263 "Confirm the first marker is shown" before "must not show the first marker"; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget L281 first-button marker "is the working control"; cw_time_limit_recovery L299 control run plus "a final valid Run must show its own new output"; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work L308 "Fails ... if the control marker never appeared" with void-attempt handling; cw_newer_run_supersedes L317 same; cw_preview_isolation L326 library entry, health address in a normal tab and localStorage set/read-back "as working controls" and "Fails ... if ordinary own-preview DOM and console activity did not work"; cw_dynamic_code_refused L335 "Fails ... if the harmless control draft is refused" and each refusal needs "a visible reason"; cw_stale_save_refused L353 "Fails ... if A's control Save did not succeed"; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft L362 "If B's Save was accepted there is no refused Save to observe and this criterion fails"; cw_history_restore_retry L371 the successful first restore (fourth revision) precedes "no fifth revision" and the stale-restore leg; cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state L389 "If A's library never shows B's snippet, this criterion fails as well"; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft L398 requires the notice, not only an untouched draft. Unchanged/nowhere-else legs in cw_block_indent_undo, cw_replace_current, cw_replace_all_atomic, cw_find_forward_backward_wrap, cw_multi_caret_* and cw_caret_navigation are each conjoined with a required positive change in the same criterion (e.g. L155 "All four matches must be replaced and the near-match must stay unchanged"; the disabled-Redo allowance comes after a required working Redo with the visible control).

Polish: cw_undo_redo_availability L50 pairs "both must be shown as unavailable" with "Type a character: Undo becomes available" and "Fails ... if the app has no visible Undo and Redo controls"; cw_unsaved_marker L59 pairs no-indication with "Fails if no unsaved indication appears after the edit"; cw_narrow_width_usable L68 pairs no sideways scroll with reaching five areas, typing and pressing Run. Gates: cw_custom_document_surface (constraints L23) starts from "Type a distinctive word into the code editor, then inspect the live DOM ... to find where that word is displayed", and the render gate (all_pass) independently requires typed text to appear.

Golden cross-check: restore replay key is in the request body (src/app.tsx:84 operationId in body; server.js:102), so the 'same method, path and body' replay exercises the idempotent path; preview is sandbox='allow-scripts' with connect-src 'none' (runtime.ts:7, 389), so the judge-authored probes produce logged failures rather than silence.

Notes (not defects, no fix required for this row): (1) cw_preview_isolation L326 does not explicitly say that each hostile probe draft's own 'obtained/failed' log line must appear; a preview that silently ran none of the probe drafts would leave only the fetch leg ('the fetch promise must reject rather than resolve') to be decided by prompt.md:9. No wrongly credited insecure app could be constructed, because the console control works and an executed probe logs what it obtained. (2) The same criterion's 'hostile marker must not appear ... in the library' leg has no probe that attempts a library write (routes may not be guessed), so it is vacuous beyond the fetch-reject leg. (3) polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus L23 exempts 'A control the app does not have at all', so an app missing Format/Find/Replace is graded only over the controls it has; the constraints gate still forces title, filename, Save, library and editor to exist, so it is not earned by an empty app. (4) polish/prompt.md has no general positive-control sentence; its criteria carry the controls inline.
